foundation: fixed Yambda-Large V0-V5; no backbone retraining

confirmation.interpretation: population confirmation at the predeclared seed17; seed robustness is estimated on main only, not falsely claimed for this panel

fitting_population_curve.note: Freeze candidate rule, validation users and optimization budget; report actual early stopping and train coverage. Do not infer saturation from a256-user run stopped before one full user pass.

controls.purpose: same-user/source training-budget control to separate interaction capacity from continued optimization; nested predecessor states preserved
controls.quality_panel: main2000, all5edges, all3seeds; confirmation2000 repeats the primary f/fg/fgh ladder at seed17

e5.selection: pre-release common validation only; existing fixed population qualification does not use learned-method scores

kv_sensitivity.interpretation: all five edges, single predeclared correction seed; no3seed stability claim for these secondary variants

protocol_sensitivity.interpretation: distinct subspace and candidate-context definitions, fully labeled; full-rank equality required in each; no cross-protocol pooling

e6.trajectory: Independent E5-trained FG and fullH each own causal writes; truncation ranks are hindsight read interventions on fixed fullH snapshots, no deployable lowrank encoder or rank-specific trajectory claim
e6.population: preserve predeclared feedback_union_2000 all5edges; expose edge4 update gain uncertainty; no method-outcome-based membership selection

common.confidence: paired UID bootstrap1000; preserve all edges/controls/seeds; primary mean uses equal-edge AUC differences before ratio
common.cost: complete added FLOPs, including calibration and all real behavior work/tails; report actual-event and analytic230-read accounts separately
common.launch: Execution remains within the active user-authorized goal. Concrete jobs follow after current source/pair/numerical/performance prerequisites pass; no additional user approval step.
common.cost_model_selection_scope: Global hyperparameter/recipe search and common-validation selection are research search overhead, recorded separately. Once a common recipe is frozen, each point charges its full per-release teacher/source preparation, fitting, its own early-stop validation, row preparation and complete events. Search overhead is not silently relabeled as serving work.

selection_status: Current240-checkpoint common comparison is the retained release-gap-only control. Before formal3seed fitting, compare a causal pre-release fitting-gap calibration alternative and common validation contexts; no learned-method main/confirmation scores used for selection.
